notes.title: Whipseey update - New Moon level!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the newest [b]Whipseey and the Lost Atlas[/b] update is now live!

This update brings a whole new level to the game!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[b]A fully fledged new level[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/7c4f13f336a6fa0c67e6d0752bcdc8a78d063ef3.png[/img]

[b]A new environment based on the moon and space[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/2d2dd865617ab43652a80e0ceb0830dfe37a558e.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/4fb4164127e10cb42116ca0d0a38a9ea27ffc4a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Whipseey and the Lost Atlas - Available now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/d6f134f25ea3e2f5908fb92532d1d9a23778533f.png[/img]

We’re very happy to announce that Whipseey and the Lost Atlas is available now on PC!

We want to thank you all who wishlisted the game or pre-ordered it on consoles (or both!) again. And special thanks to those OG members of the community who have been following the development process since the beginning. 

[h1]What is Whipseey?[/h1]

If you don’t know much about the game, this is the section for you.

Whipseey and the Lost Atlas is an action platformer inspired on classic retro games from the 90’s. It comes with adorable pixel art by artist Roy Nathan De Groot.

[h1]Curators[/h1]

If you're a Steam curator or media and you're interested in reviewing Whipseey, please [url=press@blowfishstudios.com]send us an email[/url] with all of your information and a link to your curator page, blog or channel so we can send you a code!

[h1]Socials[/h1]

For more Whipseey announcements, [url=https://twitter.com/whipseey]follow the game[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/blowfishstudios]follow us on Twitter[/url].
